project.name: cavet
project.description: A Go CLI security-triage tool for coding agents. It runs scanners (trivy, opengrep, gitleaks, checkov) inside an offline container engine and records every finding and decision in an append-only audit log.
project.context: This finding comes from a scan of the cavet repository itself.

finding.description:
engine/Dockerfile:122
Detected docker image with no explicit version attached. Images should be tagged with an explicit version to produce deterministic container images -- attach a version when using `FROM <image>`.
verdict: dismissed (high confidence, by operator): engine/Dockerfile:122 FROM scanners references the internal stage defined at line 74 of the same Dockerfile, not a registry image; internal stages cannot carry a version tag

mechanical_context.path_class: container image build definition (shipped as the scanner engine image)
mechanical_context.source_excerpt:
92 |         "https://github.com/opengrep/opengrep/releases/download/v${OPENGREP_VERSION}/opengrep_${oarch}"; \
   93 |     echo "$sha /usr/local/bin/opengrep" | sha256sum -c -; \
   94 |     chmod +x /usr/local/bin/opengrep
   95 | 
   96 | # Checkov (Apache-2.0), opt-in per repository (config.scanners.checkov).
   97 | # ponytail: pip-installed in a venv; pin drift is contained to this layer.
   98 | # setuptools: Debian's ensurepip bundles 66.1.1 into every venv (CVE-2024-6345,
   99 | # CVE-2025-47273); checkov does not depend on it, so bump it past the fixes.
  100 | RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
  101 |         python3 python3-venv \
  102 |     && python3 -m venv /opt/checkov \
  103 |     && /opt/checkov/bin/pip install --no-cache-dir --upgrade "setuptools>=78.1.1" \
  104 |     && /opt/checkov/bin/pip install --no-cache-dir "checkov==${CHECKOV_VERSION}" \
